prior_inventory.name: PoleAddressVariants
prior_inventory.scope: 24 direct-tap address controls: all six permutations of buffer/input/tap addition, (buffer+tap)[input], (buffer+input)[tap], (&buffer[input])[tap], reversed subscript forms, and product operand reversal. Row load remains (input+buffer)[row] in this grid.

prior_inventory.name: PoleBytePointer
prior_inventory.scope: 10 byte-address spellings: char* + (input+index)*2, char* + input*2 + index*2, reordered additions, and cast-back indexed short loads. Each applies to direct tap alone or both tap and row.

prior_inventory.name: PolePointer
prior_inventory.scope: 10 outer-block pointer forms: short*, const short*, or short* const samples=buffer+input, used by row alone or both loads, plus pointer advancement per row. Pointer declaration is at outer block start.

prior_inventory.name: PoleVariants
prior_inventory.scope: 360 legal permutations of the six initial local declarations, using (input+buffer)[tap/row].

prior_inventory.name: PoleLoopTypes
prior_inventory.scope: 64 int/unsigned-int/short/unsigned-short combinations for i, tap and row.

prior_inventory.name: PoleSignVariants
prior_inventory.scope: Four signed/unsigned combinations for input and output offsets.

prior_inventory.name: PoleCpp
prior_inventory.scope: C++ language control of the same pole routine.

prior_inventory.name: RootReversedRowSubscripts
prior_inventory.scope: (input+row)[buffer], row[input+buffer], input[buffer+row], and extra +0 row-load controls, plus baseline.

comparison_method: Compile each source form in the entire canonical AudioProcessing translation unit. Compare the complete native2320-byte function extent, including alignment. Only18 COFF relocation operands are masked, with symbols/addends independently checked; no SIB byte is masked. Compare all34 other raw bodies and relocation signatures against the unmodified full-unit control. Resample source is unchanged; its four previously exact bodies are not recompiled by this scope-only probe.
findings: Row-local short*, const-short*, and byte pointers produce the identical canonical pole body:2320 bytes with the same seven scale-one SIB differences.
Pointers scoped around the complete row convolution retain all seven original SIB mismatches and add13 differing bytes from induction-variable stack placement and scheduling, totaling20.
Capturing each row sample as int gives2320 bytes/1215 differing positions; short gives2336 bytes/1257. Neither recovers native code.

Every candidate preserves all34 other complete raw bodies, emitted function order, and .rdata/.data/.bss extents and bytes. Relocation identities are unchanged; the generated SEH table/label names advance, and the complete12-byte materialized table is independently proved unique at its native address. There are33 exact native functions in this unit; unsigned ADPCM remains partial.

Prior grids were inspected and their existing compiled objects rechecked, not recompiled. No additional source variants or storage are justified by these results. No canonical source or grouping change is made.
